def fn(t0, t1, k, lst, dct):
    idx1 = torch.tensor([10, 18], device=t0.device)
    t0.index_fill_(0, idx1, 5)
    t0[t0 > 2] = 4
    idx2 = torch.tensor([18, 11, 15], device=t0.device)
    t0[idx2] = -2
    v3 = t0 * 1
    v4 = t0.unsqueeze(1)
    v5 = v3.clamp(0, 2)
    return (v3, v3, lst, dct)
